gib_librarian_in.text: The Garrison Library has stood since 1793 and was built with money raised by the officers themselves, because nobody else would pay.
It's a members' library, with a fine reading room and a fine collection of old maps. It's also one of the quietest buildings in the Mediterranean.

gib_siege_reader.text: The Great Siege lasted three years, seven months and twelve days, which is the longest siege in British military history. They held on until the French and Spanish gave up in 1783.
The famous 'sortie' in 1781 destroyed the Spanish siege works in one night. It was done by the garrison under General Eliott, in the dark, with spades and torches.
